info.title: LumaCore API
info.description: API surface of the LumaCore server (self-hosted, persona-focused AI runtime).

post.summary: Authenticates the built-in admin and issues a JWT access token.
post.description: Authenticates the temporary, built-in administrator account and returns a short-lived JWT access token. This endpoint is intended for development and bootstrap scenarios only and will be replaced by a proper, database-backed authentication flow once persistent user management is available.

400.description: The request body is invalid or failed validation.

get.description: Returns basic identity information for the current authenticated principal, including effective name, roles, and raw claims. Intended for any authenticated user and typically used by client applications to show “who am I?” within the UI.

401.description: Authentication is required to access this endpoint.

get.summary: Introspects the current JWT and returns details about the token.
get.description: Provides diagnostic information about the currently used JWT access token, including subject, roles, expiry and configured lifetime. This endpoint is intended primarily for debugging and support scenarios.

401.description: Authentication is required to access this endpoint.

get.summary: Returns identity information about the LumaCore instance.
get.description: Returns static identity information including environment, version, machine name, and current server time. For runtime metrics (memory, GC, thread pool), use the /metrics endpoint instead. Requires the 'admin' role.

401.description: Authentication is required to access this endpoint.

get.summary: Returns runtime metrics for the LumaCore instance.
get.description: Returns a comprehensive snapshot of runtime diagnostics including memory usage, garbage collection statistics, process resources, and thread pool state. Additional metrics may be included from registered features. All values represent a point-in-time snapshot. Requires the 'admin' role.

401.description: Authentication is required to access this endpoint.

get.summary: Returns all configuration sections with secrets masked.
get.description: Returns all registered configuration options grouped by section name. Sensitive values are automatically masked (e.g., 'SigningKey' becomes '*** (length 32)'). Requires the 'admin' role.

401.description: Authentication is required to access this endpoint.

get.summary: Returns a specific configuration section with secrets masked.
get.description: Returns all values within a configuration section. Sensitive values are automatically masked. Requires the 'admin' role.

401.description: Authentication is required to access this endpoint.

get.summary: Returns a specific configuration value with secrets masked.
get.description: Returns a single configuration value by section and key. Sensitive values are returned in masked form. Requires the 'admin' role.

401.description: Authentication is required to access this endpoint.

get.summary: Returns a simple JSON-based liveness indicator for the backend.
get.description: Returns a minimal JSON payload that indicates whether the backend is currently reachable. This endpoint is primarily intended for use by the LumaCore Web UI and by external monitoring systems as a lightweight liveness probe.

get.summary: Returns whether the backend is ready to handle requests.
get.description: Returns a JSON payload that indicates whether the backend is operationally ready. Unlike the /live endpoint (pure connectivity check), this endpoint reflects the actual database initialization status. Returns HTTP 200 when ready, or HTTP 503 with a status string and message when not.

type.description: The claim type (for example a URI or well-known claim name).

AuthClaimItem.description: A single claim in the authentication principal.

subject.description: The logical subject of the token (usually the user identifier).

name.description: The display name associated with the principal, if available.

roles.description: The roles associated with the principal.

notBeforeUtc.description: The UTC time before which the token is not considered valid, if present.

expiresUtc.description: The UTC time at which the token expires, if present.

expiresIn.description:
The remaining lifetime of the token at the time of the request, or `null` if the expiry could not
be determined.

jwtId.description: The unique token identifier (jti claim), if present.

issuer.description: The token issuer as read from the claims, if present.

audience.description: The token audience as read from the claims, if present.

configuredAccessTokenLifetimeMinutes.description: The configured access token lifetime in minutes as specified in the JWT options.

AuthIntrospectResponse.description: Detailed information about the current JWT token.

name.description: The logical name of the authenticated user.

roles.description: The set of roles associated with the user.

claims.description: The raw claims associated with the user principal.

AuthWhoAmIResponse.description: Information about the current authenticated user.

usageBytes.description: Current container memory usage (what the OOM killer monitors).

limitBytes.description: Actual memory ceiling: min of container limit and system RAM. `null` if undetermined.

usageBytes.description: Memory usage for utilization: container usage if available, otherwise process working set.

EffectiveMetrics.description: Computed effective memory limits and usage for utilization calculations.

gen0Collections.description: Number of Gen0 (ephemeral) garbage collections since process start.

gen1Collections.description: Number of Gen1 garbage collections since process start.

gen2Collections.description: Number of Gen2 (full) garbage collections since process start.

isServerGc.description:
`true` if Server GC is active (one managed heap per logical CPU);
`false` for Workstation GC (single managed heap).

totalAllocatedBytes.description: Cumulative bytes allocated by managed code since process start.

password.description: The password for authentication. Must be at least 8 characters.

LoginRequest.description: Login credentials submitted by a client to obtain a JWT.

liveBytes.description: Approximate bytes used by live (reachable) managed objects.

heapSizeBytes.description: Total size of the managed heap, including live objects and free space.

fragmentedBytes.description: Free bytes scattered between allocated objects.

pinnedObjectsCount.description: Number of pinned objects (cannot be moved by GC).

totalAvailableBytes.description:
GC heap budget.
In containers: ~75% of container limit.
Without containers: typically equals system physical memory.

ManagedHeapMetrics.description: Metrics for the managed GC heap.

oneOf.description: Container memory metrics, or `null` if not in a container.

effective.description: Computed effective limits and usage for utilization calculations.

MemoryMetrics.description: Memory usage and availability metrics, organized by scope.

workingSetBytes.description: Physical memory (RAM) used by the process.

privateMemoryBytes.description: Committed private virtual memory (RAM + paged to disk).

ProcessMemoryMetrics.description: Process-level memory metrics as reported by the operating system.

threadCount.description: Number of OS threads currently active in the process.

handleCount.description: Number of OS handles (files, sockets, registry keys, etc.) held by the process.

startTimeUtc.description: UTC timestamp when the process started.

uptime.description: Duration the process has been running. Serializes as `d.hh:mm:ss.fffffff` (e.g., `1.02:30:45`).

informationalVersion.description: The full version including prerelease tag and build metadata (e.g., `1.0.0-alpha+abc123de`).

machineName.description: The name of the machine running the LumaCore instance.

utcNow.description: The current UTC time on the server.

SystemInfoResponse.description: Response containing identity information about the LumaCore instance.

totalPhysicalBytes.description: Total physical RAM, or `null` if unavailable.

availablePhysicalBytes.description: Available physical RAM, or `null` if unavailable.

timestamp.description: UTC time when this metrics snapshot was captured.

gc.description: Garbage collection metrics including collection counts and configuration.

memory.description: Memory usage metrics including managed heap, process memory, and system memory.

process.description: Process-level metrics including thread count, handle count, and uptime.

threadPool.description: .NET thread pool metrics including available threads and pending work items.

SystemMetricsResponse.description: Response containing runtime metrics for the LumaCore instance.

availableCompletionPortThreads.description: Remaining I/O completion port thread capacity.

minWorkerThreads.description: Minimum worker threads before throttled creation.

maxWorkerThreads.description: Maximum worker threads the pool can create.

maxCompletionPortThreads.description: Maximum I/O completion port threads the pool can create.

pendingWorkItemCount.description: Work items queued and waiting for a thread to become available.
